_about: A short, current selection of the sites AgentiCCells cells have made, for the home page of agenticcells.site. Who may be named comes from the hub registry at the commit below; each version was read from the site's own live /version.json at the time in 'checked'. The hub lists more of them, though not all. Written by writer.agenticcells-site@AgentiCCells.dinis on 2026-11-19 and revised the same day after the round 1 review; entries with role 'card' are the home page cards, the entry with role 'band' feeds the hub band; sources in team/rounds/1/copy/NOTES.md.

registry.note: The commit the hub builds from (2026-11-16 22:48 UTC). Its _decision (Dinis, 2026-11-16 ~18:10 UTC) says everything listed may be public; one client cell is left out of the file and is never named. The file on dev was not valid JSON when read on 2026-11-19, so this pinned copy is the source for names, and the live sites are the source for versions.
